It was only a few days ago that a blade mold had fallen from the sky. The Chlora took it as a gift from their goddess, Yuna. They immediately began creating blades from the mold out of any alloy they could find. Soon, their whole population had a blade from the mold.

As the last citizen gained their blade, one Chloran stood up in front of a massive crowd. He was decorated in armor made of metal and wood, covering a majority of his body. In the areas not covered, scars decorated his skin. He pulled out a scroll from a bag tied to his side and began to speak.

"Fellow Chloran, it is I, Commander **Hua Bing** of the Chloran Army. I was told by High Priestess **Li Lian** of a message she had received from Yuna. Yuna had declared, "The Flora civilization that had once lived in the Tree of Life, and had gone extinct, is still surviving," and that, "The Chloran civilization must hunt down and eliminate the savage Flora species that remains, else a great danger will befall Gaea." Now we trust this message, as previous messages Yuna has given Li Lian have never proven to be wrong. So we need your help."

"We are asking that all willing Chlora enlist into our army, so that we may wipe the Flora species off this planet. The information we have from their past and from those that were spared to teach us will prove as a major advantage. And all of you are able to fight, seeing as everyone now has a blade from the mold that Yuna has given us. We hope you will take up the call that Yuna has sent."

As he made his way down, the crowd applauded the commander. Thousands rushed up to him to enlist. By the end of the day, the army had increased tenfold, ranking in at just over ten thousand soldiers. Citizens were in support of the military, and were awaiting their strike on the Flora.

Yet in a small hut, a lone Chlora wanted none of this. She only wanted peace between the two species, and to help the Flora, stopping them from being savages. **Jiu Xing** looked outside her window to see hundreds of torches lighting up where the military were gathered. She knew that she would have to stop this madness herself if she was ever to get peace between the two species.
